description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330016541914 RING SEAL ASSEMBLY: Line 0001 Qty 12 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0015 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
